title: Unsigned LichenFrame parser exposes entire body as MIC
description: Security/correctness codereview finding in python/src/lichen/link/frame.py from_bytes(): mic_len is zero for unsigned frames, but mic = body[len(body) - mic_len:] becomes body[0:] because -0 == 0. Every successfully parsed unsigned frame therefore reports the complete LLSec/Epoch/Seq/Dst/Payload body as its MIC, contradicting the wire profile and LichenFrame._validate. LinkLayer rejects unsigned ingress today, but parser/vector/debug consumers can mistake unauthenticated bytes for integrity evidence. Special-case zero to return b"" (while preserving the full payload slice), assert parse/serialize round trips for every unsigned address/MIC selector, and coordinate with existing consumer-coverage bead c5s7 without duplicating it.
close_reason: Closed as review false positive: the slice starts at len(body) - 0, which is len(body), so unsigned mic is correctly b''; existing unsigned round-trip tests pass.
